crossRefs.note: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

translations.web: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
translations.bsb: As water reflects the face, so the heart reflects the true man.
translations.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
translations.asv: As in water face answereth to face, So the heart of man to man.
